inspection: Eight rendered pages viewed in the current task; not a full-paper visual review

pages.observation: Spaced mechanism paragraphs precede the formal model; the durable-stock interpretation is readable.
The construction-margin paragraph leads into identification; citations remain attached to the relevant contrasts.
The displayed residual has a lead-in and immediate interpretation; extraction loses some mathematical glyphs, so the rendering is necessary.
The two-line welfare decomposition is followed by definitions and rent-equivalent interpretation; conditions also appear in footnotes.
The regression is preceded by outcome and design language and followed by variable definitions; highway rays are the stated unit.
The demand-cost diagram and equation share variables and receive explicit economic interpretation; traffic quantity is the horizontal axis.
The adjustment equation is connected to an earlier price regression; a simple example then explains marginal versus mean preferences.
Separate ITT and TOT equations are surrounded by assignment, take-up, weighting, clustering, and interpretation language.
